verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلرَّابِعِ وَٱلْعِشْرِينَ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱجْتَمَعَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ بِٱلصَّوْمِ، وَعَلَيْهِمْ مُسُوحٌ وَتُرَابٌ.
verses.kjv: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.web: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

verses.ar: وَٱنْفَصَلَ نَسْلُ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ بَنِي ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ، وَوَقَفُوا وَٱعْتَرَفُوا بِخَطَايَاهُمْ وَذُنُوبِ آبَائِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.web: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

verses.ar: وَأَقَامُوا فِي مَكَانِهِمْ وَقَرَأُوا فِي سِفْرِ شَرِيعَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِهِمْ رُبْعَ ٱلنَّهَارِ، وَفِي ٱلرُّبْعِ ٱلْآخَرِ كَانُوا يَحْمَدُونَ وَيَسْجُدُونَ لِلرَّبِّ إِلَهِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God [one] fourth part of the day; and [another] fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
verses.web: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

verses.ar: وَوَقَفَ عَلَى دَرَجِ ٱللَّاَوِيِّينَ: يَشُوعُ وَبَانِي وَقَدْمِيئِيلُ وَشَبَنْيَا وَبُنِّي وَشَرَبْيَا وَبَانِي وَكَنَانِي، وَصَرَخُوا بِصَوْتٍ عَظِيمٍ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, [and] Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
verses.web: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ: يَشُوعُ وَقَدْمِيئِيلُ وَبَانِي وَحَشَبْنِيَا وَشَرَبْيَا وَهُودِيَّا وَشَبَنْيَا وَفَتَحْيَا: «قُومُوا بَارِكُوا ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْأَزَلِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، وَلْيَتَبَارَكِ ٱسْمُ جَلَالِكَ ٱلْمُتَعَالِي عَلَى كُلِّ بَرَكَةٍ وَتَسْبِيحٍ.
verses.kjv: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, [and] Pethahiah, said, Stand up [and] bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.web: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

verses.ar: أَنْتَ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ وَحْدَكَ. أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَسَمَاءَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَكُلَّ جُنْدِهَا، وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَكُلَّ مَا عَلَيْهَا، وَٱلْبِحَارَ وَكُلَّ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَنْتَ تُحْيِيهَا كُلَّهَا. وَجُنْدُ ٱلسَّمَاءِ لَكَ يَسْجُدُ.
verses.kjv: Thou, [even] thou, [art] LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all [things] that [are] therein, the seas, and all that [is] therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
verses.web: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخْتَرْتَ أَبْرَامَ وَأَخْرَجْتَهُ مِنْ أُورِ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيِّينَ وَجَعَلْتَ ٱسْمَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.web: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

verses.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ قَلْبَهُ أَمِينًا أَمَامَكَ، وَقَطَعْتَ مَعَهُ ٱلْعَهْدَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُ أَرْضَ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّينَ وَٱلْحِثِّيِّينَ وَٱلْأَمُورِيِّينَ وَٱلْفَرِزِّيِّينَ وَٱلْيَبُوسِيِّينَ وَٱلْجِرْجَاشِيِّينَ وَتُعْطِيَهَا لِنَسْلِهِ. وَقَدْ أَنْجَزْتَ وَعْدَكَ لِأَنَّكَ صَادِقٌ.
verses.kjv: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give [it, I say], to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou [art] righteous:
verses.web: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

verses.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ذُلَّ آبَائِنَا فِي مِصْرَ، وَسَمِعْتَ صُرَاخَهُمْ عِنْدَ بَحْرِ سُوفٍ،
verses.kjv: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
verses.web: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

verses.ar: وَأَظْهَرْتَ آيَاتٍ وَعَجَائِبَ عَلَى فَرْعَوْنَ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ عَبِيدِهِ وَعَلَى كُلِّ شَعْبِ أَرْضِهِ، لِأَنَّكَ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُمْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْهِمْ، وَعَمِلْتَ لِنَفْسِكَ ٱسْمًا كَهَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.kjv: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as [it is] this day.
verses.web: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

verses.ar: وَفَلَقْتَ ٱلْيَمَّ أَمَامَهُمْ، وَعَبَرُوا فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْبَحْرِ عَلَى ٱلْيَابِسَةِ، وَطَرَحْتَ مُطَارِدِيهِمْ فِي ٱلْأَعْمَاقِ كَحَجَرٍ فِي مِيَاهٍ قَوِيَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.web: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

verses.ar: وَهَدَيْتَهُمْ بِعَمُودِ سَحَابٍ نَهَارًا، وَبِعَمُودِ نَارٍ لَيْلًا لِتَضِيءَ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّتِي يَسِيرُونَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.web: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

verses.ar: وَنَزَلْتَ عَلَى جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ، وَكَلَّمْتَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ أَحْكَامًا مُسْتَقِيمَةً وَشَرَائِعَ صَادِقَةً، فَرَائِضَ وَوَصَايَا صَالِحَةً.
verses.kjv: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.web: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

verses.ar: وَعَرَّفْتَهُمْ سَبْتَكَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَ، وَأَمَرْتَهُمْ بِوَصَايَا وَفَرَائِضَ وَشَرَائِعَ عَنْ يَدِ مُوسَى عَبْدِكَ.
verses.kjv: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
verses.web: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

verses.ar: وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ خُبْزًا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ لِجُوعِهِمْ، وَأَخْرَجْتَ لَهُمْ مَاءً مِنَ ٱلصَّخْرَةِ لِعَطَشِهِمْ، وَقُلْتَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا وَيَرِثُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلَّتِي رَفَعْتَ يَدَكَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُمْ إِيَّاهَا.
verses.kjv: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
verses.web: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

verses.ar: «وَلَكِنَّهُمْ بَغَوْا هُمْ وَآبَاؤُنَا، وَصَلَّبُوا رِقَابَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَسْمَعُوا لِوَصَايَاكَ،
verses.kjv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
verses.web: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

verses.ar: وَأَبَوْا ٱلِٱسْتِمَاعَ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا عَجَائِبَكَ ٱلَّتِي صَنَعْتَ مَعَهُمْ، وَصَلَّبُوا رِقَابَهُمْ. وَعِنْدَ تَمَرُّدِهِمْ أَقَامُوا رَئِيسًا لِيَرْجِعُوا إِلَى عُبُودِيَّتِهِمْ. وَأَنْتَ إِلَهٌ غَفُورٌ وَحَنَّانٌ وَرَحِيمٌ، طَوِيلُ ٱلرُّوحِ وَكَثِيرُ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ، فَلَمْ تَتْرُكْهُمْ.
verses.kjv: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou [art] a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.web: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

verses.ar: مَعَ أَنَّهُمْ عَمِلُوا لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ عِجْلًا مَسْبُوكًا وَقَالُوا: هَذَا إِلَهُكَ ٱلَّذِي أَخْرَجَكَ مِنْ مِصْرَ، وَعَمِلُوا إِهَانَةً عَظِيمَةً.
verses.kjv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This [is] thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.web: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

verses.ar: أَنْتَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ لَمْ تَتْرُكْهُمْ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَلَمْ يَزُلْ عَنْهُمْ عَمُودُ ٱلسَّحَابِ نَهَارًا لِهِدَايَتِهِمْ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ، وَلَا عَمُودُ ٱلنَّارِ لَيْلًا لِيُضِيءَ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّتِي يَسِيرُونَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.web: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

verses.ar: وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ رُوحَكَ ٱلصَّالِحَ لِتَعْلِيمِهِمْ، وَلَمْ تَمْنَعْ مَنَّكَ عَنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ مَاءً لِعَطَشِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.web: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

verses.ar: وَعُلْتَهُمْ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ فَلَمْ يَحْتَاجُوا. لَمْ تَبْلَ ثِيَابُهُمْ، وَلَمْ تَتَوَرَّمْ أَرْجُلُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, [so that] they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.web: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

verses.ar: وَأَعْطَيْتَهُمْ مَمَالِكَ وَشُعُوبًا، وَفَرَّقْتَهُمْ إِلَى جِهَاتٍ، فَٱمْتَلَكُوا أَرْضَ سِيحُونَ، وَأَرْضَ مَلِكِ حَشْبُونَ، وَأَرْضَ عُوجٍ مَلِكِ بَاشَانَ.
verses.kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.web: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.ar: وَأَكْثَرْتَ بَنِيهِمْ كَنُجُومِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَأَتَيْتَ بِهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي قُلْتَ لِآبَائِهِمْ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا وَيَرِثُوهَا.
verses.kjv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess [it].
verses.web: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

verses.ar: فَدَخَلَ ٱلْبَنُونَ وَوَرِثُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَأَخْضَعْتَ لَهُمْ سُكَّانَ أَرْضِ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّينَ، وَدَفَعْتَهُمْ لِيَدِهِمْ مَعَ مُلُوكِهِمْ وَشُعُوبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَعْمَلُوا بِهِمْ حَسَبَ إِرَادَتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.web: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذُوا مُدُنًا حَصِينَةً وَأَرْضًا سَمِينَةً، وَوَرِثُوا بُيُوتًا مَلآنَةً كُلَّ خَيْرٍ، وَآبَارًا مَحْفُورَةً وَكُرُومًا وَزَيْتُونًا وَأَشْجَارًا مُثْمِرَةً بِكَثْرَةٍ، فَأَكَلُوا وَشَبِعُوا وَسَمِنُوا وَتَلَذَّذُوا بِخَيْرِكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ.
verses.kjv: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
verses.web: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

verses.ar: وَعَصَوْا وَتَمَرَّدُوا عَلَيْكَ، وَطَرَحُوا شَرِيعَتَكَ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ، وَقَتَلُوا أَنْبِيَاءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْهَدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَرُدُّوهُمْ إِلَيْكَ، وَعَمِلُوا إِهَانَةً عَظِيمَةً.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.web: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

verses.ar: فَدَفَعْتَهُمْ لِيَدِ مُضَايِقِيهِمْ فَضَايَقُوهُمْ. وَفِي وَقْتِ ضِيقِهِمْ صَرَخُوا إِلَيْكَ، وَأَنْتَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ سَمِعْتَ، وَحَسَبَ مَرَاحِمِكَ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ أَعْطَيْتَهُمْ مُخَلِّصِينَ خَلَّصُوهُمْ مِنْ يَدِ مُضَايِقِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest [them] from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.web: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ لَمَّا ٱسْتَرَاحُوا رَجَعُوا إِلَى عَمَلِ ٱلشَّرِّ قُدَّامَكَ، فَتَرَكْتَهُمْ بِيَدِ أَعْدَائِهِمْ، فَتَسَلَّطُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا وَصَرَخُوا إِلَيْكَ، وَأَنْتَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ سَمِعْتَ وَأَنْقَذْتَهُمْ حَسَبَ مَرَاحِمِكَ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ أَحْيَانًا كَثِيرَةً.
verses.kjv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest [them] from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
verses.web: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

verses.ar: وَأَشْهَدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إِلَى شَرِيعَتِكَ، وَأَمَّا هُمْ فَبَغَوْا وَلَمْ يَسْمَعُوا لِوَصَايَاكَ وَأَخْطَأُوا ضِدَّ أَحْكَامِكَ، ٱلَّتِي إِذَا عَمِلَهَا إِنْسَانٌ يَحْيَا بِهَا. وَأَعْطَوْا كَتِفًا مُعَانِدَةً، وَصَلَّبُوا رِقَابَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَسْمَعُوا.
verses.kjv: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.web: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

verses.ar: فَٱحْتَمَلْتَهُمْ سِنِينَ كَثِيرَةً، وَأَشْهَدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرُوحِكَ عَنْ يَدِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ فَلَمْ يُصْغُوا، فَدَفَعْتَهُمْ لِيَدِ شُعُوبِ ٱلْأَرَاضِي.
verses.kjv: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.web: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ لِأَجْلِ مَرَاحِمِكَ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ لَمْ تُفْنِهِمْ وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْهُمْ، لِأَنَّكَ إِلَهٌ حَنَّانٌ وَرَحِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou [art] a gracious and merciful God.
verses.web: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

verses.ar: «وَٱلْآنَ يَا إِلَهَنَا، ٱلْإِلَهَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ ٱلْجَبَّارَ ٱلْمَخُوفَ، حَافِظَ ٱلْعَهْدِ وَٱلرَّحْمَةِ، لَا تَصْغُرْ لَدَيْكَ كُلُّ ٱلْمَشَقَّاتِ ٱلَّتِي أَصَابَتْنَا نَحْنُ وَمُلُوكَنَا وَرُؤَسَاءَنَا وَكَهَنَتَنَا وَأَنْبِيَاءَنَا وَآبَاءَنَا وَكُلَّ شَعْبِكَ، مِنْ أَيَّامِ مُلُوكِ أَشُّورَ إِلَى هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.kjv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.web: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

verses.ar: وَأَنْتَ بَارٌّ فِي كُلِّ مَا أَتَى عَلَيْنَا لِأَنَّكَ عَمِلْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ، وَنَحْنُ أَذْنَبْنَا.
verses.kjv: Howbeit thou [art] just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
verses.web: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

verses.ar: وَمُلُوكُنَا وَرُؤَسَاؤُنَا وَكَهَنَتُنَا وَآبَاؤُنَا لَمْ يَعْمَلُوا شَرِيعَتَكَ، وَلَا أَصْغَوْا إِلَى وَصَايَاكَ وَشَهَادَاتِكَ ٱلَّتِي أَشْهَدْتَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
verses.web: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

verses.ar: وَهُمْ لَمْ يَعْبُدُوكَ فِي مَمْلَكَتِهِمْ وَفِي خَيْرِكَ ٱلْكَثِيرِ ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَيْتَهُمْ، وَفِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْوَاسِعَةِ ٱلسَّمِينَةِ ٱلَّتِي جَعَلْتَهَا أَمَامَهُمْ، وَلَمْ يَرْجِعُوا عَنْ أَعْمَالِهِمِ ٱلرَّدِيَّةِ.
verses.kjv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.web: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

verses.ar: هَا نَحْنُ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَبِيدٌ، وَٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلَّتِي أَعْطَيْتَ لِآبَائِنَا لِيَأْكُلُوا أَثْمَارَهَا وَخَيْرَهَا، هَا نَحْنُ عَبِيدٌ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Behold, we [are] servants this day, and [for] the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we [are] servants in it:
verses.web: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

verses.ar: وَغَلَّاتُهَا كَثِيرَةٌ لِلْمُلُوكِ ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلْتَهُمْ عَلَيْنَا لِأَجْلِ خَطَايَانَا، وَهُمْ يَتَسَلَّطُونَ عَلَى أَجْسَادِنَا وَعَلَى بَهَائِمِنَا حَسَبَ إِرَادَتِهِمْ، وَنَحْنُ فِي كَرْبٍ عَظِيمٍ.
verses.kjv: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we [are] in great distress.
verses.web: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

verses.ar: «وَمِنْ أَجْلِ كُلِّ ذَلِكَ نَحْنُ نَقْطَعُ مِيثَاقًا وَنَكْتُبُهُ. وَرُؤَسَاؤُنَا وَلَاوِيُّونَا وَكَهَنَتُنَا يَخْتِمُونَ».
verses.kjv: And because of all this we make a sure [covenant], and write [it;] and our princes, Levites, [and] priests, seal [unto it].
verses.web: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”
